text: Factory acceptance test of the DCS and the SIS with the complete configuration (graphics, logic, sequences, alarms, redundancy failure injection, cybersecurity baseline) per ER-15.03; site acceptance per ALP-EPC-00000-IC-TST-0001 with the loop checks of 100 % of the I/O and the functional tests of every sequence and trip; SIL proof of the SIS installation and the validation per IEC 61511.
